summary: Iteration 9 - VERIFIED FIX for the persistence bug (create_token now includes unique jti + get_savings_goals tolerates legacy docs). Backend: 6/6 pytest cases PASSED (100%) — (1) 10 back-to-back logins for the same user produced 10 UNIQUE access_token strings (jti proven present and unique via jwt.decode); (2) 6 rapid logout+login cycles within the same second: /api/me returned SAME user id every time, GET /api/transactions still returned the seed tx, GET /api/savings-goals still returned the seed goal — no data erased, no 401 'Session ended'; (3) after logout, the OLD token returns 401 while a fresh token issued in the same second returns 200 (logout scope correct); (4) GET /api/savings-goals with a synthetically inserted legacy doc (no name/celebrated/created_at) returns 200 with defaulted fields ('Savings goal', celebrated=false, created_at=updated_at) — legacy tolerance regression guarded; (5) user id stable across 5 independent logins. Frontend (mobile 390x900): fresh signup 'perstXXXXXXXX' → created 'Persist Goal' (₹1,000) via add-goal-btn → added ₹250 expense (Food) via add-transaction-fab → performed 5 rapid logout(open-settings → settings-logout)+login(auth-username/password/auth-submit) cycles back-to-back. AFTER EACH cycle the dashboard showed 'Persist Goal' card AND the ₹250 Food transaction (balance -₹250, low-balance-alert visible) — 0 cycles erased data, 0 'Session ended' errors, 0 red screens. Deprecated packages detected: none. React-Native issues detected: only pre-known 'shadow*' style-props web deprecation warning (non-blocking, already tracked in iter7/iter8).

critical_code_review_comments: create_token now signs {sub, jti=uuid4(), iat, exp} — unique per call regardless of second-precision iat/exp. Bug root cause correctly eliminated: two calls in the same second produce different tokens because jti differs.

logout still upserts the exact token string into db.revoked_tokens and current_user still rejects any incoming token whose exact string is in that collection — logout revocation scope is preserved for the specific old token only (verified in TestLogoutRevocationScope).

get_savings_goals defaults name='Savings goal', celebrated=False, created_at=updated_at (or now) for legacy docs — GET returns 200 instead of 500 (verified by directly inserting a legacy doc lacking those fields and calling the endpoint).
User data is owner_id scoped by stable user['id'] (uuid, never changes across logins) — /api/me returns the same id across 5+ independent logins.

revoked_tokens collection can grow unbounded. Non-blocking, but consider a TTL index on 'expires_at' (already stored on each doc) to auto-purge expired revoked tokens — file: /app/backend/server.py:396.
Frontend correctly re-fetches transactions/goals after login (state re-hydrated from server) — no localStorage-only caching; owner-scoped server data is source of truth.

To reproduce the fixed bug on a HYPOTHETICAL regression: sign up user, take a token, logout immediately, login again — the new token must NOT equal the old one and /api/me on the new token must NOT return 'Session ended'. This is now guarded by TestUniqueTokenPerLogin and TestRapidLogoutLoginPreservesData in test_iter9.py.
rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE (confirmed): pre-fix create_token signed only {sub, iat, exp} with second-precision timestamps. When JWT_SECRET, sub, iat, and exp were all identical (rapid logout+login in the same second), the resulting JWT string was byte-identical to the just-revoked one, so current_user hit the revoked_tokens denylist and returned 401 'Session ended' — the app then showed empty state (appeared 'erased' though data was owner_id-safe on the server). FIX (confirmed working): add a per-token unique 'jti'=uuid4() claim in create_token so no two tokens ever collide; logout revocation still keys on the token string, so it only invalidates the specific old token. Legacy savings-goals docs from the earlier single-goal endpoint used to 500 the list endpoint because required fields (name/celebrated/created_at) were absent — get_savings_goals now setdefaults them, verified by direct Mongo insertion.
